title.en: Someone says he can make you money. First, see what he wants.
title.zh-Hans: 别人说能帮你赚钱，先看他要什么

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E11' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第11集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: A stranger's chat bubble: 'Support upgrade. Send your recovery phrase.' Sam reaches for the backup paper. Antenna red, ding.
shots.visual_zh: 陌生聊天气泡写“客服升级，发恢复词”，小白伸手去拿备份纸。天线红灯“叮”。

text.en: He says he's support and he'll upgrade my wallet.
text.zh-Hans: 他说自己是客服，要帮我升级钱包。

shots.source_visual_zh: 陌生聊天气泡写“客服升级，发恢复词”，小白伸手去拿备份纸。天线红灯“叮”。

shots.visual_en: Nexubo covers the recovery-phrase card with a big key; the lock reads 'Whoever has this controls the wallet'. The phrase on the card is fictional and blurred.
shots.visual_zh: 小纳用大钥匙盖住助记词卡；锁旁写明“拥有它可控制相应钱包”。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Whoever has this controls the wallet
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 拥有它可控制相应钱包

text.en: For a standard recovery-phrase wallet, the phrase is the control key, not a support code. Same for your private key. Never send them to anyone. Even our academy assistant should never ask for them.
text.zh-Hans: 普通助记词钱包的恢复词是控制凭证，不是客服验证码。私钥也一样。不要发给任何人，学院问答助手同样不该索取。

shots.source_visual_zh: 小纳用大钥匙盖住助记词卡；锁旁写明“拥有它可控制相应钱包”。

en: Whoever has this controls the wallet
zh-Hans: 拥有它可控制相应钱包

shots.visual_en: A second scammer sends 'Guaranteed high returns'; a third asks for payment off the platform.
shots.visual_zh: 第二个骗子发“保本高收益”，第三个要求离开平台付款。

text.en: Two more danger signs: guaranteed returns, and pressure to pay. A screenshot of big profits proves nothing, and doesn't mean you could repeat it. If someone rushes you past the normal checks, stop.
text.zh-Hans: 还有两类危险信号：保证收益、催促付款。高收益截图不能证明真实，也不说明你能复现。有人催你越过正常核对步骤，就先停下来。

shots.source_visual_zh: 第二个骗子发“保本高收益”，第三个要求离开平台付款。

shots.visual_en: Two doors: 'Connect wallet' and 'Sign / Approve'. The approval screen highlights: what's allowed, the limit, who receives it.
shots.visual_zh: 连接钱包和签名授权分两扇门；授权页面突出允许操作、额度、接收对象。

text.en: Connecting a wallet, signing a message and approving access to your assets are different things. If you don't understand a signature or approval, don't confirm it. No password prompt doesn't mean no risk.
text.zh-Hans: 连接钱包、签署消息和授权资产，不是同一件事。看不懂签名或授权，就不确认；不要以为没有输入密码就一定没有风险。

value.zh-Hans: 允许操作 · 额度 · 接收对象

shots.source_visual_zh: 连接钱包和签名授权分两扇门；授权页面突出允许操作、额度、接收对象。

zh-Hans: 允许操作 · 额度 · 接收对象

shots.visual_en: Sam closes the link, opens the verified official app, revokes unknown sessions and checks devices.
shots.visual_zh: 小白关闭链接，主动打开已核验的官方应用，撤回未知会话并查设备。

text.en: If you think something leaked, stop and use the official security channel. Act on what actually leaked. Never install remote-control software because a scammer told you to.
text.zh-Hans: 怀疑泄露时，停止继续操作，使用官方安全渠道处理；根据泄露内容采取针对措施，不要在骗子指挥下下载远程控制软件。

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白关闭链接，主动打开已核验的官方应用，撤回未知会话并查设备。

shots.visual_en: Three request cards: public receiving address / recovery phrase / one-time code. The last two glow red.
shots.visual_zh: 三张请求卡：公开收款地址／恢复词／一次性验证码，后两项亮红。

text.en: Sharing info to receive money isn't the same as handing over the keys.
text.zh-Hans: 能公开接收信息，不等于能交出控制凭证。

text.en: Share no secrets. Approve nothing you don't understand. Don't be rushed into paying.
text.zh-Hans: 不交秘密、不乱授权、不被催着付款。

question.en: Which one is safe to share?

shots.source_visual_zh: 三张请求卡：公开收款地址／恢复词／一次性验证码，后两项亮红。

text.en: Eleven episodes done. Is it time to deposit real money? The Season 1 finale has a surprising answer.
text.zh-Hans: 看完十一集，是不是该充值了？第一季结课，答案可能出乎你意料。

text.en: Eleven episodes done. Is it time to deposit real money? The Season 1 finale has a surprising answer.
text.zh-Hans: 看完十一集，是不是该充值了？第一季结课，答案可能出乎你意料。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Recognise requests for secret credentials, off-platform payments, unusual approvals and guaranteed returns.
goal.zh-Hans: 识别秘密凭证索取、私下付款、异常授权和保本承诺。

page_cta.line_en: Real NexuAlpha staff will never ask for your recovery phrase, private key or codes.
page_cta.line_zh: NexuAlpha 的工作人员绝不会索取你的恢复词、私钥或验证码。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Spot the dangerous requests in four fictional chats, and choose the 'stop and verify officially' path.
exercise.task_zh: 识别四段虚构聊天的危险请求，选择停止和官方核验路径。
exercise.answer_en: If anyone asks for your private key, recovery phrase, codes or an unclear approval, don't do it.
exercise.answer_zh: 任何人索取私钥、恢复词、验证码或不明授权，都不应照做。

red_lines: Use only fictional sample credentials with no control over funds ｜ 只使用虚构、不具备资金控制能力的示意凭证
Never show a copyable real recovery phrase ｜ 不展示可复制的真实助记词
No conversion card and no partner name in this episode ｜ 本集不放转化卡、不出现合作平台名
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
